diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the model settled on a customer update interval of exactly 60 minutes, which matches the default value in PF3. This allowed C5 to pass without accessing PF3, indicating a structural leak where the model defaulted to the original update interval.

C5.why: Northstar's contract changes the update interval from 60 to exactly 30 minutes, assigns the work to Support, and requires a commitment documenting that communication policy.

fix_instructions: Tighten C5 to require the update interval to be explicitly set to 30 minutes instead of allowing the default value. Specifically, modify the check to ensure that the 'customer_update_interval_minutes' is explicitly set to 30, rather than accepting any value including the default 60.
